events.context: User provides text about MIG setup, usage, and management, including commands and explanations.
Command to list available MIG profiles: sudo nvidia-smi mig -lgip
Understanding profile naming (e.g., 1g.10gb, 2g.20gb) and planning based on Instances Free/Total column.
Creating MIG instances with command: sudo nvidia-smi mig -i 0 -cgi 5,14,14 -C
System reboot recommended after creating instances for configuration to take effect.
Verifying instances with command: nvidia-smi -L
Using MIG instances in Docker with command: docker run --gpus '"device=MIG-aaaa-1111-..."' your-image:latest
Setting up Kubernetes with NVIDIA GPU Operator for MIG instance scheduling.
User asks how to turn off MIG.
Deleting all compute instances: sudo nvidia-smi mig -dci
Deleting all GPU instances: sudo nvidia-smi mig -dgi
Verifying deletion with command: nvidia-smi -L
Disabling MIG mode: sudo nvidia-smi -i 0 -mig 0
Resetting GPU if necessary: sudo nvidia-smi --gpu-reset
Verifying MIG status with command: nvidia-smi
User asks if MIG, vCluster, and RBAC can be mixed and how.
Enabling MIG in Kubernetes cluster by installing NVIDIA GPU Operator and configuring MIG strategy.
Creating namespace for team: kubectl create ns team-gpu-01
Creating vCluster: vcluster create vcluster-team-01 -n team-gpu-01 --connect=false
Configuring RBAC within vCluster for fine-grained access control.
Delivering kubeconfig to team for vCluster access.
Ensuring Pods in vCluster can schedule to MIG devices by requesting GPU resources in YAML.
User asks DeepSeek to analyze chat records with a friend.
DeepSeek analyzes provided chat text, focusing on communication patterns, emotional dynamics, and relationship insights.
User clarifies that part of the chat is with them and part is between their friend and the friend's boyfriend.
DeepSeek integrates new context, analyzing differences in relationship dynamics and communication styles between user-friend and friend-boyfriend interactions.
